args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website at www.dora-website.com. It's a nice, clean introduction — I like that it immediately tells visitors it's your personal site and how to reach you directly. A couple of suggestions to make it even stronger: add a bit more about yourself (your interests, work, or what you're passionate about) so visitors have something to connect with, and consider adding links to your other profiles or projects. Overall, a warm and approachable start — keep it up!

Hi Eve! I had a look at your blog at www.eve-blog.com. I love that you share your passion for hiking — it's a great topic and it really comes through in the description. A few ideas to make the blog more engaging: post some of your hikes with photos and trail details (distance, difficulty, best season), add a few recent entries so visitors can see the blog is active, and maybe include a short intro about who you are and why you love hiking. Looking forward to reading more!
